title: 第2章 为孩童武魂觉醒，千仞雪听到斗罗星求救
slug: 斗罗千仞雪穿绝世重振武魂殿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“太贵？”

“对，觉醒一次要五金魂币。有时候还不止，比如我们这偏僻的小村庄——春华村，魂师大人们要跋山涉水，费用更高。”

“五金魂币！”

千仞雪发现，来到这个后世，她的三观和认知正被一遍遍地刷新。

这个费用在她武魂殿统治的时期，但凡有人敢提出来，下一秒便被砍了。

想她武魂殿统治时代，压着两大帝国进行全大陆武魂免费觉醒，可如今时代在进步，武魂觉醒反而还开始收钱呢！

历史在开倒车就算了，还要五金魂币一次！

这个费用普通家庭不吃不喝一年都不一定攒得齐，结果告诉她还不止？！

这个时代真的是她认为的后世吗？

千仞雪拳头捏得死紧。

“大人？”

“没关系，孩子。我来替你们进行武魂觉醒，不要钱。但需要麻烦你们，将这个消息告诉附近的几个村庄。

将所有适龄孩子聚集在一起，三天后，就在这个广场，我替你们逐一觉醒，好吗？”

“真的吗？太好了！多谢您魂师大人！”

被嘱咐的孩子一阵欢呼，而她的母亲则是惶恐不已，“大人，这？”

“无妨，不过举手之劳而已。”

是啊，举手之劳而已，其实武魂觉醒根本没有任何含金量，区区一个大魂师就能做到，而且所用的费用，就算加上觉醒石也不过几十铜魂币而已。

将几个村庄的孩童聚集在一起后，费用更少，结果这个离谱的时代居然要五金魂币。

即使是千仞雪都看不下去了。

反正搞不清楚自己为何突然来到这个后世，就先把眼前不平之事全都解决了再说吧。

千仞雪叹息，看着村民们得知此事后欢呼雀跃，清理家园时也更有斗志了，她的心情才好受了些。

之后也婉拒了村民的高规格对待，只寻了一件无人的房子住了进去。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Too expensive?"

"Yes, one awakening costs five soul coins. Sometimes more. For example, in our remote village - Chunhua Village, the soul masters have to travel across mountains and rivers, and the cost is even higher."

"Five gold soul coins!"

Qian Renxue discovered that in this future life, her views and cognition were being refreshed over and over again.

During the period when she ruled the Wuhun Palace, anyone who dared to raise this fee would be cut off in the next second.

I remember that during her reign in the Spirit Hall, she suppressed the two empires to carry out the free awakening of martial spirits across the continent, but now that the times are progressing, she has begun to charge money for the awakening of martial spirits!

Even if history is going in reverse, I still need five soul coins!

An ordinary family might not be able to save this amount for a year without food or drink, but she was told that it was more than enough?!

Is this era really what she thinks it will be in the future?

Qian Renxue clenched her fists tightly.

"My lord?"

"It's okay, kid. I'll help you awaken your martial soul for free. But I need to trouble you and tell the news to several nearby villages.

Gather all the children of school age together. Three days later, in this square, I will wake up for you one by one, okay?"

"Really? That's great! Thank you, Master Soul Master!"

The child who was ordered cheered, while her mother was horrified, "Sir, this?"

"It doesn't matter, it's just a piece of cake."

Yes, it's just a piece of cake. In fact, awakening a martial soul has no gold content at all. A mere great soul master can do it, and the cost, even with the awakening stones, is only a few dozen copper soul coins.

After gathering children from several villages together, the cost was less, but in this outrageous era, five soul coins were actually required.

Even Qian Renxue can't stand it anymore.

Anyway, I don’t know why I suddenly came to this future life, so I’ll just settle all the injustices in front of me first.

Qian Renxue sighed and felt better after seeing the villagers cheering and having more fighting spirit when cleaning their homes.

After that, he declined the high-standard treatment from the villagers and only found an unoccupied house to live in.
